language_note: Mother tongue, 2002 census, for the municipality as it was before its 2013 merger into Kichevo -- the unit the map draws; the 2021 census publishes mother tongue for the merged Kichevo only. The book's Vlach is shown as Aromanian, as for the rest of the country.
religion_note: Declared religion, 2002 census, for the municipality as it was before its 2013 merger into Kichevo -- the unit the map draws; the 2021 census publishes religion for the merged Kichevo only. 'Other religion' is the book's 'others', which it does not divide.
